assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Monitoring Food Temperatures
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Provide accurate thermometers to check internal food temperature on site. Check and record temperatures before and after transport. Monitor and record temperatures every 2 hours thereafter. If minimum temperatures are not maintained, food will be discarded.
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Have probe thermometer to use at the booth Have additional thermometers to use at the booth, for example infrared Staff will check and record food temperatures every 2 hours N/A
